BC_description: The property 'killed' on instances of the ExecaError class has been renamed to 'isTerminated'. Downstream code that previously relied on 'error.killed' to determine process termination status must be updated to use 'error.isTerminated' instead. Note: Both 'isTerminated' and 'signal' properties have partial platform support and may not reliably reflect process termination on Windows. Refer to release_note.md#v9.0.0 and issue #625 for additional context.
